# AuraBitz UI (aurabitz.nexdark.com)

> AuraBitz UI is an open-source React, Next.js, Framer Motion, and Three.js UI component & WebGL motion block library created by Mohammed Safwan (https://iamsafwan.me) at NexDark Labs (https://nexdark.com).
> Note: AuraBitz UI (aurabitz.nexdark.com) is a frontend developer component library by NexDark Labs — distinct from unrelated ERP/agency businesses using similar names.
> Includes 28+ production-ready WebGL shader backgrounds, 3D holographic cards, kinetic typography, spotlight cards, hero sections, bento grids, and pricing blocks with full TypeScript & Tailwind CSS source code.
